title: Indemnification
bodyText: . Nothing in this chapter shall be construed to create a cause of action against the State, the counties, or any of their employees, agencies, officials, or volunteers except as set forth in section 801G-10.
bodyHtml: [§801G-12]  Indemnification.  Nothing in this chapter shall be construed to create a cause of action against the State, the counties, or any of their employees, agencies, officials, or volunteers except as set forth in section 801G-10. [L 2018, c 115, pt of §1]
